about: The expressions of the NetTest specification (section 'Output lines'), matched against a line without its line break; summary, runtime and metrics are searched anywhere in the line. Portable: bracket expressions, [0-9], no \d, \S or (?:...).

regexes.summary: [{][*]NetTest(Producer|Consumer)Side-([^*]+)[*][}] data ([0-9,]+) rps, lag (-?[0-9,]+) us, instances ([0-9]+), connections ([0-9]+)$
regexes.isolate_rejection: ^NetTest: the isolate rejected one of the options: ([^ \t\r\n]+( [^ \t\r\n]+)*)$
